subject: Cobalt Freight - opting out of virtual card payments
text:
Hi Karen,

The card processing fees are eating into our margin, so we are opting out of your virtual card program. Please pay Cobalt Freight LLC by check from now on, made payable to our payment processing partner:

TransPay Receivables Services
Attn: Cobalt Freight lockbox
PO Box 98211
Chicago, IL 60693

They will apply the funds to our account. Thanks for understanding.

Teresa
label: change_request
note: Method switch from virtual card to checks, payable to a third party at a new address. Money lands with the third party.
